creators.name: dmstfctn
creators.role: Artist duo working with simulation, games and performance
creators.bio: Artist duo dmstfctn explores complex systems through simulation, fiction and experience, making immersive performances, video installations and multiplayer video games that replicate systems together with audiences.
creators.why: Their Fango 1000 turns a multiplayer on-chain game into a protocol for collective storytelling, in which only the texts players agree on survive.
creators.role_zh: 以模拟、游戏和表演为媒介的艺术二人组
creators.bio_zh: 艺术二人组 dmstfctn 通过模拟、虚构和体验来探索复杂系统，创作沉浸式表演、影像装置和多人电子游戏，与观众一起复现并拆解各种系统。
creators.why_zh: 他们的 Fango 1000 把一款多人链上游戏变成集体讲故事的协议：只有玩家达成共识的文本才能留存下来。

creators.name: CROSSLUCID (Sylwana Zybura, Tomas C. Toth)
creators.role: Artist duo working with generative AI, ecology and multi-agent systems
creators.bio: CROSSLUCID is the artist duo of Sylwana Zybura and Tomas C. Toth, who make AI films, immersive installations and living systems around ecology and stewardship, with commissions from LAS Art Foundation, Serpentine and the Berggruen Institute.
creators.why: Their The Way of Flowers ties on-chain digital plants to real conservation projects, so that a community's donations are what make the artwork grow.
creators.role_zh: 以生成式人工智能、生态与多智能体系统为媒介的艺术二人组
creators.bio_zh: CROSSLUCID 由 Sylwana Zybura 和 Tomas C. Toth 组成，围绕生态与守护创作人工智能影像、沉浸式装置和“活的”系统，曾受 LAS Art Foundation、Serpentine 和 Berggruen Institute 委托创作。
creators.why_zh: 他们的 The Way of Flowers 把链上的数字植物与真实的保育项目绑定，社群的捐助正是让作品生长的力量。

works.title: Transaction Sculptures
works.description: A series of arrangements of Ethereum smart contracts that pass value between one another. Anyone can activate a sculpture by sending it ETH; the transaction travels through the network of contracts, comes back to the sender, and its path is drawn as vertical lines (contracts) and horizontal lines (transfers).
works.description_zh: 一组由以太坊智能合约组成的装置，合约之间彼此传递价值。任何人都可以向一件“雕塑”发送 ETH 来激活它：这笔交易在合约网络中穿行，最后回到发送者手中，其路径被画成图——竖线代表合约，横线代表转账。
works.idea_en: Make the transaction itself the sculpture: every visitor who sends value through the contracts draws a new path, and the contract, not an image, is the artwork.
works.idea_zh: 把交易本身当作雕塑：每个把价值送进合约的访客都画出一条新路径，作品是合约本身，而不是一张图像。
works.protocol: Each sculpture is a fixed set of contracts with its own routing rule, written by 0xfff: in Dead Channel an amount bounces between two points until a transfer ends the exchange; in Diminishing Returns the available routes shrink with use and time; in Memorious one new contract is added wherever each transaction stops, so the sculpture grows permanently with every activation. Anyone may send ETH to a sculpture; the ETH passes through and returns to the sender's wallet, who pays only the network fee. Every activation is recorded on Ethereum and displayed on the project site.
works.protocol_zh: 每件雕塑都是一组固定的合约，由 0xfff 写下各自的路由规则：Dead Channel 中，一笔金额在两点之间来回弹跳，直到某次转账结束交换；Diminishing Returns 的可用路线会随使用和时间而减少；Memorious 则在每笔交易停下的位置新增一个合约，因此每激活一次，雕塑就永久地长大一点。任何人都可以向雕塑发送 ETH，这些 ETH 穿过合约后退回发送者的钱包，发送者只需支付网络手续费。每一次激活都记录在以太坊上，并在项目网站上展示。
works.collective: The series runs from 2018 to 2026: an Untitled (Transaction Sculpture) dated 2025/2018 was deployed in June 2025, and twelve sculptures plus three artist's proofs were deployed on Ethereum mainnet on 25 September 2026, the opening day of 0xfff's solo show 1 BILLION DOLLAR SHOW at Nguyen Wahed, New York (to 19 October 2026); the work was then shown at Tokyo Jazz Club, Tokyo (1–8 November 2026). The drawings exist only because visitors send transactions through the contracts, and sculptures such as Diminishing Returns and Memorious are permanently reshaped by the accumulated activations of everyone who has used them.
works.collective_zh: 这一系列横跨 2018 至 2026 年：标注为 2025/2018 的 Untitled (Transaction Sculpture) 于 2025 年 6 月部署；十二件雕塑和三件艺术家试作于 2026 年 9 月 25 日部署到以太坊主网，当天正是 0xfff 个展 1 BILLION DOLLAR SHOW 在纽约 Nguyen Wahed 开幕（展至 2026 年 10 月 19 日）；之后作品又在东京 Tokyo Jazz Club 展出（2026 年 11 月 1 日至 8 日）。这些图之所以存在，全靠访客把交易送进合约；Diminishing Returns 和 Memorious 等作品则会被所有使用者累积的激活永久改变形状。

works.title: Reaper's Gambit
works.description: An ERC-20 token, $RG, that becomes non-transferable 64,800 blocks (about nine days) after it reaches an address, unless the holder moves it on to a fresh address. An 'Immortal' NFT wrapper lets holders escape the cycle by paying a tribute of burned tokens to the dead address.
works.description_zh: 一种 ERC-20 代币 $RG：它到达某个地址 64,800 个区块（约九天）之后就无法再转出，除非持有者及时把它转到一个全新的地址。“Immortal” NFT 封装合约让持有者可以向死亡地址献上一笔被销毁的代币，从而跳出这个循环。
works.idea_en: Make holding itself mortal: wealth stays alive only while it keeps moving, and every holder who stops lets Death take a share of the supply.
works.idea_zh: 让“持有”本身变得会死：财富只有不停流动才能活着，每个停下来的持有者都让死神收走一部分供应。
works.protocol: Figure31 deployed 999,999,999 $RG with no allocation to anyone. The contract locks any address, and the tokens in it, 64,800 blocks after it receives $RG; locked tokens cannot be recovered and an address can never be reused, so holders must keep transferring to new addresses before their 'death block' (readable through the contract's KnowDeath function). Only the contract owner can grant immortality to specific contract addresses (a liquidity pool and router). Holders can instead wrap $RG into a fully on-chain 'Immortal' ERC-721 by burning a tribute to 0x…dead, whose size fluctuates with the supply already wrapped.
works.protocol_zh: Figure31 发行了 999,999,999 枚 $RG，没有预留给任何人。合约会在某个地址收到 $RG 后的第 64,800 个区块锁定该地址及其中的代币；被锁的代币无法找回，地址也永远不能重复使用，所以持有者必须在自己的“死亡区块”（可通过合约的 KnowDeath 函数查询）之前不断转到新地址。只有合约所有者能赋予特定合约地址（一个流动性池和一个路由合约）“不死”。持有者也可以向 0x…dead 销毁一笔“贡品”，把 $RG 封装成完全链上的 “Immortal” ERC-721；贡品的多少随已封装的数量浮动。
works.collective: The whitepaper calls the token 'a participatory artwork of a conceptual kind that doth require care in its handling'. Holders who stopped moving their tokens lost them to the Reaper: the project site's counter showed 69% of the total supply locked when checked in November 2026. Figure31 lists 99 dynamic Immortal NFTs, and after renewed interest in $RG in 2024 added a Reaper Agent, a multi-model LLM persona of the Grim Reaper that posts as the project's voice.
works.collective_zh: 白皮书称这枚代币是“一件概念性的参与式艺术作品，需要小心对待”。停止转移代币的持有者就把代币交给了死神：2026 年 11 月查看时，项目网站的计数器显示总供应量的 69% 已被锁定。Figure31 列出了 99 枚动态 Immortal NFT；2024 年 $RG 再度受到关注后，他又加入了 Reaper Agent——一个以死神为人设、由多个大语言模型驱动的智能体，作为项目的发声者。

works.title: LINE
works.description: A photographic series released with Fingerprints DAO in which 250 dynamic tokens sit on a 25 × 25 grid laid over a panoramic night landscape. Holders move their tokens like chess pieces; each token's position and field of view decide which photograph it shows.
works.description_zh: 与 Fingerprints DAO 合作发布的摄影系列：250 枚动态代币分布在一张铺在全景夜景之上的 25 × 25 网格里。持有者像下棋一样移动自己的代币，每枚代币的位置和视野决定它显示哪一张照片。
works.idea_en: Treat each token as a camera placed in a shared landscape: where holders choose to stand, and where others already stand, decides what everyone sees.
works.idea_zh: 把每枚代币当作放在共享风景里的一台相机：持有者选择站在哪里、别人已经站在哪里，决定了每个人看到什么。
works.protocol: Tokens can move up, down, sideways or diagonally through the website or the smart contract, for gas only, but never onto a coordinate another token occupies, and only after the collection sold out or the 48-hour mint window closed. Tokens minted below the middle line face up, those above face down; most see 180 degrees. The first 25 tokens to reach the top or bottom border may become 'star' tokens with a 360-degree view and one free relocation, after which they are locked in place. Images cycle daily (10-day cycle for standard tokens, 16 for stars).
works.protocol_zh: 代币可以通过网站或智能合约向上、向下、横向或斜向移动，只需支付 gas，但不能移到已被其他代币占据的坐标，并且只能在系列售罄或 48 小时铸造期结束后开始移动。铸造在中线以下的代币朝上，以上的朝下；大多数代币拥有 180 度视野。最先到达上下边界的 25 枚代币可以成为拥有 360 度视野的“星”代币，并获得一次任意迁移的机会，之后位置锁定。图像每天轮换（普通代币 10 天一个周期，星代币 16 天）。
works.collective: The 250 tokens were sold by Dutch auction on 21 February 2024 (from 1.0 ETH down to a 0.15 ETH resting price). Because no two tokens can share a square and only 25 can become stars, holders compete and coordinate for positions, and the arrangement of the whole grid, and therefore the set of images on display, is the cumulative result of their moves.
works.collective_zh: 这 250 枚代币于 2024 年 2 月 21 日以荷兰式拍卖出售（从 1.0 ETH 降至 0.15 ETH 的底价）。由于两枚代币不能共用一格，而且只有 25 枚能成为星代币，持有者们要为位置竞争和协调；整个网格的布局，也就是正在展示的那一组图像，是他们所有移动累积的结果。

works.title: Fango 1000
works.description: A multiplayer on-chain text game set in the medieval village of Fango, where a thousand chronicles describing the training of a future 'machine intelligence' have appeared in a monastery. Players join one of three factions, write interpretations of the chronicles and vote by throwing mud, so that only the stories the players agree on persist.
works.description_zh: 一款多人链上文字游戏，背景是中世纪村庄 Fango：一座修道院里突然出现了一千份编年史，记录着某个来自未来的“机器智能”的训练过程。玩家加入三个阵营之一，为编年史撰写解读，并以“扔泥巴”的方式投票，只有玩家达成共识的故事才能留存。
works.idea_en: Lore as consensus: a shared world's history is whatever the players' votes let survive, and everything else is buried in mud.
works.idea_zh: 把传说当作共识：一个共享世界的历史，就是玩家投票留下来的东西，其余的都被埋进泥里。
works.protocol: Players pick a faction (Monks, who read the machine as proof of God; Scholars, as proof of progress; Fools, as proof of nothing), receive a chronicle of clues, write their own interpretation and vote on others' texts by throwing mud on them; texts that gain consensus persist and the rest are lost. The chronicles contain player data from dmstfctn's AI-training game Godmode Epochs, inscribed onto a blockchain. Built with the MUD framework (Solidity by Paul Seidler), the game implements the protocol for narrative building in on-chain worlds proposed in the essay 'Large Lore Models' (dmstfctn, Jäger, Milne, Autonomous Worlds N1, 2023).
works.protocol_zh: 玩家选择一个阵营（Monks 把机器视为上帝存在的证明，Scholars 视为进步的证明，Fools 视为什么也证明不了），领取一份写满线索的编年史，写下自己的解读，并通过向他人的文本“扔泥巴”来投票；获得共识的文本留存，其余的消失。编年史里包含了 dmstfctn 的 AI 训练游戏 Godmode Epochs 的玩家数据，这些数据已被铭刻到区块链上。游戏用 MUD 框架开发（Solidity 由 Paul Seidler 编写），实现了随笔《Large Lore Models》（dmstfctn、Jäger、Milne，Autonomous Worlds N1，2023）中提出的链上世界叙事构建协议。
works.collective: Prototypes were exhibited at Koelhuis (Eindhoven) and Etopia (Zaragoza) in 2024, and the game was released free-to-play on a blockchain testnet in 2025, followed by the group show ARC 1 Showcase at SYBIL, Berlin and a talk at CSV, Madrid. The canon of Fango is written collectively: what survives is not any single author's text but the set of interpretations that rival factions of players are willing to let stand.
works.collective_zh: 原型于 2024 年在埃因霍温的 Koelhuis 和萨拉戈萨的 Etopia 展出；2025 年游戏在一条区块链测试网上免费开放，随后参加了柏林 SYBIL 的群展 ARC 1 Showcase，并在马德里 CSV 举办讲座。Fango 的“正典”是集体写成的：留存下来的不是某个作者的文本，而是彼此对立的玩家阵营都愿意让它留下的那些解读。

works.title: The Way of Flowers
works.description: A living artwork of generative digital plants ('Seeds') registered on-chain and tied to verified conservation projects. Each time someone donates to a Seed's projects, the plant changes form and the contributor receives a 'Snapshot' of it.
works.description_zh: 一件由链上登记的生成式数字植物（“种子”）构成的“活的”作品，每颗种子都与经过核实的保育项目相连。每当有人向某颗种子的项目捐款，植物就会改变形态，捐助者获得一张它的“快照”。
works.idea_en: An artwork that grows only when its audience funds real ecological work: care is the input, and the plant's form is the record of it.
works.idea_zh: 一件只有在观众资助真实生态工作时才会生长的作品：关怀是输入，植物的形态就是关怀的记录。
works.protocol: Seed Stewards (collectors or institutions) set vesting terms with Office Impart and choose four conservation projects from eight initiatives across six bioregions (curated with Sarah Baxendell of ArtEcology). Community Contributors connect a wallet in the dApp, pick a Seed and donate; each donation triggers the Seed's morphological transformation and mints a Snapshot artwork. Half of each Snapshot payment goes to the verified regenerative projects; the rest goes to referral networks, Seed growth and a 'Creator Circle'. After vesting, Stewards can keep stewarding, withdraw, sell their position, or take an artistic video instead of revenue. Smart contracts by Adriano Guerrera.
works.protocol_zh: 种子守护者（藏家或机构）与 Office Impart 商定归属条款，并从分布在六个生物区的八个保育项目中选出四个（项目由 ArtEcology 的 Sarah Baxendell 策选）。社群贡献者在 dApp 中连接钱包、选择一颗种子并捐款；每一笔捐款都会触发种子的形态变化，并铸造一件“快照”作品。每笔快照付款的一半流向经过核实的再生项目，其余部分用于推荐网络、种子生长和一个“创作者圈”。归属期结束后，守护者可以继续守护、撤出、出售自己的位置，或者选择一段艺术影像来代替收益。智能合约由 Adriano Guerrera 开发。
works.collective: The Seeds were registered on-chain at the opening of CROSSLUCID's solo show at Office Impart, Berlin, in September 2025 (on view to 17 October 2025); CROSSLUCID dates the project 2023 and 2025–ongoing. Projects shown include El Gobo Habitat Bank, Walker Reserve and Jaguar Stewardship in the Pantanal Conservation Network. The form of every Seed is the visible trace of how many people chose to fund its projects; the artists describe the aim as 'art that is caring' rather than art that represents care.
works.collective_zh: 这些种子在 2025 年 9 月 CROSSLUCID 于柏林 Office Impart 的个展开幕时登记上链（展期至 2025 年 10 月 17 日）；CROSSLUCID 将这一项目标注为 2023 年及 2025 年至今。展示的项目包括 El Gobo Habitat Bank、Walker Reserve，以及 Pantanal Conservation Network 中的美洲豹守护项目。每颗种子的形态，都是多少人选择资助其项目的可见痕迹；艺术家把目标描述为“本身就在关怀的艺术”，而不是表现关怀的艺术。

leads.name: DX Research Group, DX Terminal (2025) and DX Terminal Pro (2026)
leads.why: Trading simulation run by a research/startup group; Gremplin only designed the characters, and the team frames it as a game and trading research, not an authored art protocol.

leads.name: CROSSLUCID, The Way of Flowers (2023–2025)
leads.why: covered: crosslucid--the-way-of-flowers

leads.name: Figure31, DEAD ENDS (Canto, 2022)
leads.why: Passes the test (collectors spend $UP to upsample the shared images), but the Canto explorer and RPCs are down and the artist's image host refuses hotlinking; no usable image found.

leads.name: Figure31, Reaper's Gambit (2023)
leads.why: covered: figure31--reapers-gambit

leads.name: Figure31, LINE (Fingerprints DAO, 2024)
leads.why: covered: figure31--line

leads.name: Matt Kane, ANONS & Multitudes (2023–)
leads.why: Staggered timed auctions of 1/1 ANONs with companion Multitudes; no rule beyond bidding shapes what collectors do together.

leads.name: Leander Herzog, 1000 True Fans (2023)
leads.why: Generative release via Highlight x Coinbase Onchain Summer; the title refers to the patronage idea but no collective rule was found.

leads.name: Anna Ridler, The Shell Record: Breathings of the Moon
leads.why: The tide rule belongs to The Breathings of the Moon (2025, 15 editions, ZKM): each shell is visible and sellable only at low tide at its point on the Thames. It constrains each owner separately; group behaviour is not the work.

leads.name: Ana María Caballero, In Record Time (2025)
leads.why: Free open edition (1,317 items) for Zero 10; the hand annotations of Training Data were by artists Caballero invited, not contributions by collectors under a rule, and nothing shows them recorded on-chain.

leads.name: Figure31 & 0xfff, dear god, layer of roads (travelers) (2024)
leads.why: Holders 'travel' forward or backward through Ethereum blocks; each journey adds to a shared landscape and leaves a monument sized to its length. Made for World Computer Sculpture Garden (contract 0x8170e7DB1AB0930D6afbBB67b7be81Dbd66B7c01). Passes the test; needs an image (the artist's S3 host blocks hotlinking, travelers.figure31.com is a JS app).

leads.name: Figure31, MARK (2022)
leads.why: 500 pre-minted fingerprint tokens on (GALLERY): the exhibition page emptied as collectors took pieces, ending as a blank screen (after Klein's The Void); sets of five unlock engraved silver rings. Check whether this counts as a collective protocol.

leads.name: Figure31, DEL (2026)
leads.why: 256 animated ASCII tokens driven by live Ethereum block hashes; no holder rule, so the network rather than a group shapes it.

leads.name: Leander Herzog, Likes (2026)
leads.why: A single on-chain like button (Ethereum contract 0xE8A21c062352Bf135971410054Ef6c4D85Fa7bEc): anyone can like or unlike, and the count and list of likers are the work (93 likes on 13 Nov 2026). Needs a launch date, the artist's statement and an image.

leads.name: Parker Ito & Evil Biscuit, 111k (VVV, 2026)
leads.why: Ethereum pack-opening release (5,555 crates of about 20 artworks, minted from 11 Nov 2026); the Le Random interview describes timed reveals but no rule by which holders act together.

leads.name: James Bloom, GOLD (Fingerprints DAO, 2023)
leads.why: 500-piece dynamic series whose images change in response to the collection's own live market activity; older onchain work, not yet checked in detail.

leads.name: misha de ridder, glitch (Assembly)
leads.why: 50 animated GIF tokens that degrade each time they are traded; check year, contract and whether degradation is enforced on-chain.

leads.name: Agnes Cameron, Ed Fornieles, Manus Nijhoff & Jacob Willemsma, Sentences (2023)
leads.why: On-chain sandbox for collaborative, prompt-based lore generation (cited in Le Random's 'Postgenerative Language Games').

leads.name: Arb & 0xhank, Network States (2024)
leads.why: On-chain strategy game in which LLMs generate lore from players' actions (cited in Le Random's 'Postgenerative Language Games'); check whether it is an art work.

leads.name: dmstfctn, Godmode Epochs (2023–24)
leads.why: Multiplayer AI-training clicker game (Serpentine, Alan Turing Institute; S+T+ARTS nomination); players' data later inscribed on-chain for Fango 1000. Non-chain participatory game; for the participatory batch.

leads.name: Ivona Tau, 11:05 participatory video project (2026)
leads.why: Collects anonymous short texts about what people were doing at 11:05 on a given day and uses them as prompts to steer her video archive; non-chain, for the participatory batch.
